text:
JAILER:
  The Duke himself came here in secret, in the night, and so did they.
  (Palamon and Arcite appear above.)
  Why he did it, I don't know.
  Look, there they are. That's Arcite looking out.
DAUGHTER:
  No, sir, no, that's Palamon.
  Arcite is the shorter of the two. You can see a bit of him.
JAILER:
  Come on, stop pointing. They don't want to be stared at by the likes of us.
  Get out of their sight.
DAUGHTER:
  Just looking at them is like a holiday.
  Lord, how different men can be!
  (They leave.)
